articles.title: ‘We are in a kind of war’: row over viral Amsterdam chip shop lands in court
articles.description: Neighbours say crowds drawn by TikTok to Fabel Friet are clogging the picturesque canal street and attracting litter, gulls and rats People living in one of Amsterdam’s most exclusive neighbourhoods have taken the city to court for licensing a chip shop that has gone viral on TikTok . On busy days, the queue for Fabel Friet on Runstraat stretches across a bridge on the Keizersgracht – one of Amsterdam’s three main canals – a court was told last week. The narrow street itself is crowded by tourists waiting for their orders seven days a week. And loitering with intent – on parked cars, on the street itself, and on steps and porches – gulls wait to swoop. Continue reading...

articles.title: Can nuclear reactors really travel by truck? The tiny power plants raising huge questions about cost, safety and security
articles.description: For decades, nuclear power has been associated with enormous plants, complex infrastructure and large cooling systems. A new generation of microreactors is trying to change that picture. These reactors are designed to be small enough to move. Some could fit into containers that can be transported by truck, cargo plane or ship. Their output would be much smaller than that of a conventional nuclear plant.

articles.title: Rate hike may hurt select NBFC segments, but broad asset stress unlikely: Report
articles.description: Nuvama Institutional Equities suggests that an RBI rate hike may not broadly impact NBFC asset quality. The report indicates that past rate increases did not lead to widespread deterioration. Current risks, including the West Asia conflict, appear limited to specific NBFC segments. Healthy capital buffers and liquidity may support overall asset quality for most NBFCs. Any future deterioration is expected to be specific, contingent on external shocks.

articles.title: Adani Airports to revamp Mumbai T1 North section from Jan; 9% traffic to shift
articles.description: Adani Airports will commence a phased redevelopment of Mumbai airport's Terminal 1 starting in January 2027. The initial phase will impact around 5 million passengers each year due to safety concerns. Airlines can temporarily shift operations to the newly opened Navi Mumbai International Airport to minimize disruptions. The redevelopment aims to increase Terminal 1's capacity by 33% once completed.

articles.title: The 1952 El Portal Church sat boarded up for a decade. After a $5.5 million sale in 2021, its future became a major redevelopment fight- here's what actually happened to the historic 75-year-old church
articles.description: In El Portal, a long-abandoned church has been bought by Elm Springs for commercial development. However, Adam Neumann has since taken control, envisioning its transition into SOLFL School, a private educational institution for 350 students. Local residents voiced strong opposition to the church's demolition during a recent town hall, highlighting the significance of preserving the structure amidst a growing push for mixed-use developments in the area.

articles.title: Next financial crisis may stem from cyberattack or geopolitical shock, RBI governor says
articles.description: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said the next financial crisis may be triggered by geopolitical shocks, cyberattacks or technology failures rather than the banking system itself, calling for stronger resilience across markets, payments, non-banks and critical infrastructure. He said India’s financial system remains strong, but warned that “today’s resilience” does not guarantee immunity from future shocks.

articles.title: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra flags rising financial risks, warns against complacency as West Asia conflict adds to inflation pressure
articles.description: Sanjay Malhotra highlighted the need for vigilance regarding financial vulnerabilities at the Kautilya Economic Conclave. He emphasized that banking and financial stress can develop suddenly yet take years to resolve. Malhotra pointed out the interplay of geopolitical and economic factors complicating current financial stability predictions. He stressed the Reserve Bank of India's role in maintaining financial resilience through appropriate regulations and supervision.
